_comment: Azure Static Web Apps deployment config. This file is copied from apps/web/public/ to the static export root (out/) and picked up by SWA. It exists to harden the app's security posture: the Phase 1 session token lives in localStorage (see src/lib/auth.ts), so the headers below are the shipped mitigation — a CSP that confines scripts/styles/images to this origin, plus the standard hardening set. 'unsafe-inline' on script-src/style-src is required because a pure static export cannot inject per-response nonces into Next's inline hydration payloads and style attributes. connect-src allows https: and localhost because NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL is a build-time variable pointing at the VeriPay API origin — tighten it to that exact origin when it is known.

/*.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' http://localhost:* https:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
